topic: get rid of a musty smell in a front-load washing machine
core_question: How do I stop my front-load washer from smelling musty? (secondary: How should I store leather shoes for months so they don't get damaged?)
answer_summary: Run a hot empty cycle with white vinegar or a washing-machine cleaner tablet to clean the drum and gasket, and leave the door ajar between washes to prevent mildew.; after the topic shift: Clean and condition the shoes, insert shoe trees to hold their shape and absorb moisture, then store them in breathable cloth/dust bags (not sealed plastic) in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.
